phase_label: Site preparation and temporary traffic management
description: Dismantling of the existing pedestrian passage, installation of the temporary Bailey bridge, work-zone delimitation and temporary traffic management.
Temporary relocation of underground utilities and construction of abutment micropiles worked from the existing road surface under alternating one-way traffic.
Excavation for the new abutments and execution of the reinforced-concrete abutment works, including the set-back of the left abutment.

phase_label: Existing bridge demolition and steel superstructure installation
description: Demolition of the existing arch deck and abutments, followed by erection of the corten steel braced deck and its bolted connections and bearings.

phase_label: Deck slab construction and utility reinstatement
description: Construction of the predalles connecting slab with shear studs, completion of abutment works, expansion joints and permanent utility reinstatement.

phase_label: Road finishing, guardrail installation and completion
description: Waterproofing and pavement works on the raised road surface, roadside restraint system installation, site restoration and removal of all temporary works.
